title.zh: OpenAI Gives Ukraine Access to Daybreak AI Cyber-Defense Tool
title.en: OpenAI Gives Ukraine Access to Daybreak AI Cyber-Defense Tool

current_state.zh: OpenAI is providing Ukraine's government with access to Daybreak, its AI tool for finding and fixing software vulnerabilities, ahead of potential exploitation by Russian hackers.
